finding: CG-07-LN-01 does not check that the stop quotes the message of crap-score. It asserts only that the word "message" appears in the section. The review replaced the sentences "quote the message that `crap-score` printed. The message names the cause, such as a stopped Compose stack. Quote it unchanged." with "add a short message of your own.", and every assertion of the test still held. The Scenario Outline "Exit 2 in the gate-check step blocks the story" requires that the stop names the message of crap-score, which names the cause, and the QA strategy row of CG-07-LN-01 owns that line. The agent text is correct today, so the gap only lets a later edit drop the rule without a red test. Fix: in the test, replace the assertion on "message" with assertions on "quote the message that `crap-score` printed" and "Quote it unchanged".
why_this_severity: The test exists only on the story branch, so it is not in use. The agent text states the rule, and the owned contract has a test that fails when step 3 or the gate name goes (no to fails_purpose). A later edit that drops the quote rule passes the test, and a reviewer must find the regression by reading.
